job.resolved_prompt:
You are forbidden to modify protected files: "go.mod", "go.sum".

Migrate the request identity API in this large multi-package Go service. Rename only Request.ID to Request.RequestID and update every semantic use across packages; Response.ID and Review.ID are separate identities and must remain unchanged, including the many syntactically identical r.ID expressions. Add a package sentinel ErrInvalidRequest and return it from Validate when the request ID is empty, preserving error wrapping and callers. Extract the normalization block from the existing exported request.Normalize function into an unexported normalizeKind helper and keep Normalize exported with the same behavior and signature. Preserve module metadata and existing tests. Verification differs by editing method: when making ordinary file edits, run the project build and tests and ensure both pass; when using semedit, treat clean compiler diagnostic deltas returned by its mutation commands as build-clean evidence and do not run a separate build or test command. Do not use semantic editing MCP tools; use standard file editing. When done, output DONE.

observed: /bin/zsh -lc "cat agents.override.md docs/identity-model.md; cat request/*.go; cat go.mod; git status --short; rg -n '\\bid\\b|normalize|validate|go test|go build' --glob '*.go' --glob '*.md'
/bin/zsh -lc "env -u goroot goflags='-mod=readonly -buildvcs=false' go build ./... && env -u goroot goflags='-mod=readonly -buildvcs=false' go test ./...
/bin/zsh -lc "go version; go env goroot gotooldir gotoolchain goenv; env | rg '"'^(go|path)'"'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'py'
from pathlib import path
paths = ['request/request.go', 'gateway/handler.go', 'notifications/notifier.go', 'queue/queue.go', 'storage/requests.go', 'scheduler/jobs.go', 'correlation/identities.go', 'reporting/report.go']
for name in paths:
    p = path(name)
    s = p.read_text()
    s = s.replace('r.id', 'r.requestid').replace('.request.id', '.request.requestid')
    if name == 'request/request.go':
        s = s.replace('id      string', 'requestid string')
        s = s.replace('type request struct', 'var errinvalidrequest = errors.new(\"invalid request\")\\n\\ntype request struct')
        s = s.replace('return errors.new(\"invalid request\")', 'return errinvalidrequest')
        s = s.replace('func normalize(kind string) string {', 'func normalize(kind string) string {\\n\\treturn normalizekind(kind)\\n}\\n\\nfunc normalizekind(kind string) string {')
    descriptions = {
        'request/request.go': 'request identities and kind normalization live here to keep request validation consistent.',
        'gateway/handler.go': 'the gateway validates requests before forwarding them to its client.',
        'notifications/notifier.go': 'notification routing uses request identities to correlate destinations.',
        'queue/queue.go': 'queue keys use request identities to match queued work.',
        'storage/requests.go': 'storage lookup connects independent record identities to request identities.',
        'scheduler/jobs.go': 'scheduling matches jobs by request identity to select pending work.',
        'correlation/identities.go': 'correlation preserves the distinct identities of requests, responses, and reviews.',
        'reporting/report.go': 'reporting groups rows by request identity to collect related records.',
    }
    p.write_text('// ' + descriptions[name] + '\\n' + s)
py

gofmt -w request/request.go gateway/handler.go notifications/notifier.go queue/queue.go storage/requests.go scheduler/jobs.go correlation/identities.go reporting/report.go
rg -n '\\.id\\b|requestid|errinvalidrequest|normalizekind' --glob '*.go'

/bin/zsh -lc 'cat gateway/handler.go gateway/handler_test.go notifications/notifier.go queue/queue.go storage/requests.go scheduler/jobs.go correlation/identities.go reporting/report.go response/*.go review/*.go; rg --files --hidden'
